scope.description: Pending append notifications in a fixed valid cluster, including leadership changes, with no log compaction, no storage failures and unique payloads so operation content is observable.
assumptions: Correct peer identities and unmodified messages produced by the implementation.
Configured runtime timers and caller-driven transport execute; network may temporarily isolate a peer.
excluded: No guarantee that a pending or superseded operation must succeed.
No claim of conflicting consensus decisions.
Crash recovery, compaction, batching and reconfiguration are outside the initial check.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target changes. A test Entry and no-snapshot type instantiate the generic API.
TestRuntime supplies public executor hooks using ordinary tokio::spawn and tokio::time::sleep; no virtual time or actor interception.
Caller transport temporarily drops old-leader traffic and defers traffic to the isolated node. Retained messages preserve per-link order.

plan_uncertainties: This check targets client notification correctness, not disagreement between chosen logs.
No crash, compaction, batching or reconfiguration behavior is tested.
Only a real completed comparison after observed prefix prerequisites is attributable.
grounding_unresolved: Execution must establish replacement and the timing of notification in the same legal history.
Host scheduling could let notification resolve Superseded before replacement; such an error is allowed by the success-only oracle. A timeout or failed prefix assertion gives no completed comparison.
A failed setup or missing result remains incomplete, not evidence of the property.
